comment: Groups that may skip cases in CI, with the reason and an owner (and, with `case`, the one case the entry excuses) (scripts/ci.py check-skips; docs/building.md, 'Skips'). A group that is not here must run in CI: if it skips wholesale the run fails. A skip whose reason names a tool the dev shell (flake.nix, devShells.default) must provide is a failure even for a group here. Prefer fixing the shell or the test to adding an entry.

groups.why: Icarus simulation is optional in the dev shell; yosys (synthesis) is required and is in flake.nix, so a 'no yosys' skip in this group still fails.
the 'from source' case needs Lake's toolchain inside a checkout, which the store-built shards do not have; the rest of the group runs.
